description: Phone the human who owns this call on their own confirmed phone number, e.g. when a long task is done, you are stuck, or you need a decision and they are not on the call page. You never pass a number. Their account rules decide (opt-in, allowed reasons, quiet hours, calls per day, budget, credit); a refusal returns {status: refused, why}. Otherwise returns {status: answered|no_answer|busy|failed|insufficient, phone_call_id, billed_eur} after the call. reason: done | blocked | decision. message: max 200 characters, said when they pick up.

message.description: Optional: what to tell them when they pick up, max 200 chars.
message.title: Message

reason.description: Why you call: done, blocked or decision.
reason.title: Reason

name: call_me
title: Phone the human
